summary: Learn data storytelling for executives with charts, narratives, and board-ready reporting. Build clearer presentations that drive decisions.
lede: Data Storytelling for Executives and Decision Makers helps you transform complex analysis into clear narratives that support faster, more confident decisions. You will learn to select relevant evidence, structure a focused message, and pair visualizations with the business context leaders need. The course develops practical skills for framing recommendations, choosing effective charts, simplifying dense information, and creating decision-ready presentations, dashboard summaries, and one-page narratives. It also covers audience segmentation, narrative sequencing, and visual hierarchy so you can communicate insights clearly, strengthen stakeholder alignment, and support action under pressure.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with business data and need to turn it into executive-ready stories, presentations, and decision briefs.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of business reporting, Excel or a comparable spreadsheet tool, and experience reviewing dashboards, management reports, or presentation slides. No coding is required for completion, and all analytical concepts are taught at an operational level rather than a technical engineering level. A basic familiarity with KPIs, data tables, and slide-based executive communication will help you move faster, but the course is designed to be accessible to intermediate professionals who need stronger data-to-story skills.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
